## Try It Out!
### Restrict Sharetribe access by email domain

Automatically approve users who sign up with an allowed email domain (e.g., @company.com) and leave others in pending approval. Perfect for corporate or organization-restricted marketplaces.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `user/created` events with the full user resource.
* An IF node checks if the user's email ends with the allowed domain.
* Matching users are automatically approved; others remain in `pendingApproval` for manual review.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Enable "Require user approval" in Console > Build > General.
3. Update the IF node's domain value (e.g., `@company.com`, `@university.edu`).
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* User approval enabled in marketplace settings

### How to customize
* Add multiple domain conditions using the OR combinator for multiple allowed domains.
* Add a Gmail node on the false branch to notify rejected users.
* Chain with Update Permissions to grant different access levels per domain.
* Add logging to Google Sheets for audit purposes.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for new users
Polls for `user/created` events with the full resource to access the user's email address.

## 2. Check email domain
Verifies the user's email ends with the allowed domain. Update `@company.com` to your required domain.

## 3. Approve the user
Approves users with matching email domains, setting their state to active.
